source: after.test.ts (the tests the core's cases/after.json excludes)

cases.name: a delay computed from the context sets when the delayed transition fires
cases.test: after.test.ts > delayed transitions > delay expressions > should evaluate the expression (function) to determine the delay (the spy on the context the delay receives is the delay it reads from it, 500)

cases.name: a delay computed from the event that entered the state sets when the delayed transition fires
cases.test: after.test.ts > delayed transitions > delay expressions > should evaluate the expression (string) to determine the delay (the spy on the event the delay receives is the delay it reads from it, 500)

excluded.test: after.test.ts > delayed transitions > should format transitions properly
excluded.reason: inspects the internal transitions Map of a state node directly (the keys of lightMachine.states.green.transitions), without any actor; no step or query of the actor cases exposes a state node's definition

excluded.test: after.test.ts > delayed transitions > should execute an after transition after starting from a state resolved using `.getPersistedSnapshot`
after.test.ts > delayed transitions > should execute an after transition after starting from a persisted state
excluded.reason: restores an actor from a persisted snapshot (createActor with the snapshot option, after a JSON round trip of getSnapshot()); restoring a snapshot is out of scope, and no step starts an actor from one

excluded.test: after.test.ts > delayed transitions > should not try to clear an undefined timeout when exiting source state of a delayed transition
excluded.reason: what it asserts is the clock: XState's scheduler must not call the clock's clearTimeout when the exit of the source state cancels a delayed event that has already fired (a custom clock with a clearTimeout spy); the oracle runs every case on its SimulatedClock and records no clock call, while the value it also checks is what the core's 'transition after delay through yellow' shows; it would need a record of the clock's clearTimeout calls
